  | notes       = Memorial Ribbon is an item that was released to raise awareness for a fund helping those affected by the events at the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013 (see {{OnWikipedia|Boston_Marathon_bombings|Boston Marathon bombings (wikipedia)}}). It was available from April 30, 2013 to May 12, 2013 on the [[DDO Store]] for 100 [[DDO Point]]s. Simultaneously, a coupon was released that allowed people to get 10 of these per account for free.

This item, when used, creates a yellow/blue ribbon effect above the character's left shoulder, that is visible to everyone and stays until death or logout.
